fufu 0.19.0 adds `fufu.pull`, a per-branch policy for how a branch takes in a moved base. Path arguments now resolve from the current directory, and two bugs that could misplace a branch's parked change are fixed.

## Pull policy

`fufu.pull` is `auto` (the default), `replay`, or `merge`, and `fufu.<pattern>.pull` sets it per branch by glob. `auto` replays a straight line and leaves a branch standing once its commits hold any merge; `replay` replays the branch, flattening a merge of the base; `merge` leaves a branch behind its base standing. [`ff config pull`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/cli/config/) lists the setting and every pattern row with its scope. See [configuration](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/config/#common-settings).

The policy governs [`ff pull`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/cli/pull/)'s base step and the cascade under rewriting verbs, which report a branch left standing as behind its base, naming the policy and where it was set. The branch a verb was given still replays. [`ff resolve`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/cli/resolve/) with no hold merges the base into a branch left standing and refuses a branch that should replay, pointing to [`ff restack`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/cli/restack/). In JSON, the skip reason `merge-in-range` is now `behind`, carrying `policy` and `source`.

## Paths from the current directory

Path arguments on [`ff log`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/cli/log/), [`ff diff`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/cli/diff/), [`ff show`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/cli/show/), [`ff restore`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/cli/restore/), [`ff commit`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/cli/commit/), `ff absorb`, and `ff lift` resolve from the current directory instead of the repository root. A path outside the repository is refused with `usage/no-such-path`, as is an `ff restore` path that matches nothing.

## Miscellaneous

- A conflicting `ff restack` of a branch other than the current one, directly or through `ff pull`, no longer replaces that branch's parked change with the current working tree.
- [`ff done`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/cli/done/) on a resolution whose parked change conflicts with the landed tip keeps the hold, and `ff resolve` lays the parked change into the working copy with markers.
- The [agent setup guide](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/agents/setup/#claude-code-auto-mode) shows the permission rules that keep Claude Code's auto mode from refusing `ff` commands.
